info.title: Recalm API Cost Check
info.description: Development contract; not a live sales offer. One declared provider/account/time scope and owner-defined success criterion. Explicit joins only; no fraud/refund conclusions. No input persistence or external model calls. No production server URL configured. Approved commercial terms: JPY 1 tax-inclusive per success, monthly arrears, below JPY 50 carried forward, below JPY 50 waived on cancellation, monthly JPY 1000 stop. Not activated. Minimal Billing Meters integration prepared; all activation flags false. UTC first-day midnight anchor, total outstanding JPY 1000 cap, durable sender with <23h uncertain retries and manual hold afterwards. No live Checkout/credentials are configured.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque client-generated identifier unique per logical call. Retry with identical UTF-8 body. Account scoped; retained while account namespace and HMAC key remain intact.

unit.description: Integer smallest unit. money:USD:2 amount 20 = USD 0.20; money:JPY:0 amount 1 = JPY 1; credits:vendor:0 is a separate vendor credit unit. No conversion or currency validation.

200.description: Completed reconciliation and atomic usage receipt. Unknown results are valid completed calls. This does not collect payment. A replay recomputes the result without incrementing usage.

unit.description: Integer smallest unit. money:USD:2 amount 20 = USD 0.20; money:JPY:0 amount 1 = JPY 1; credits:vendor:0 is a separate vendor credit unit. No conversion or currency validation.

successfulCallsThisMonth.description: Current UTC month count, shared by all credentials for this account

outstandingJpy.description: Single local liability ledger: successful units minus verified collected funds and approved waivers. Carry is not added a second time.

400.description: Invalid JSON, schema or idempotency key; not metered

401.description: Missing, expired, disabled or unknown credential; not metered

409.description: Same account/key used with a different byte-exact body or algorithm version; not metered

413.description: Body exceeds 16384 UTF-8 bytes; not metered

415.description: Wrong content type or compressed input; not metered

429.description: UTC monthly successful-call cap, total outstanding JPY 1000 including carry/unbilled/unpaid amounts, or receipt safety capacity reached; rejected new call is not recorded

503.description: Unavailable or billing hold. A DO commit followed by RPC/connection failure may leave usage status unknown. Do not assume free; retry the same key and identical body. Definitively rejected inputs are not recorded.

408.description: Body read deadline of 2 seconds exceeded; not metered

post.description: Fail closed until verified Stripe-hosted Checkout and matching active subscription/UTC periods. Uses signed lifecycle webhooks and monthly/total-debt safety caps. New calls atomically append receipt, JPY 1 liability and durable outbox. Replay computes existing v1 result without new liability, while credential/config remain valid.

post.description: Existing pre-provisioned dedicated customer/account only. Does not issue keys or create prices. Requires explicit accepted terms. Session success page grants no access; signed webhook confirmation is required. Metered line has no quantity and UTC anchor is first day 00:00:00. Last 30 minutes before the anchor refuse new session.
